messages:
ops_zoe: Vendor notified a customs classification flag in FRA. They propose splitting the shipment: rush 6 H200 by air direct-to-depot (AMS-Depot-3) and send remaining 18 H100 by sea to NL cross-dock. We need a decision on air surcharge vs customer impact; thermal racks in eu-west-1 are degraded.

vendor_nathan: We can air 6 H200 at +$1.7k/unit (includes fast-track customs clearance). Sea for the bulk is standard freight but adds ~11 days. If you accept the air surcharge we can prepay duties for the air leg (+$475 flat). Insurance options: vendor 20% / customer 80% on air, 50/50 on sea; alternatively we can take 35/65 vendor/customer across both if you want unified terms.

sre_liam: Cluster update: eu-west-1 has three NVLink-degraded hosts (eu-west-1-n12/n13/n14) and a thermal margin warning on rack r9. If only 6 H200 arrive early, prioritize replacing r9 and the NVLink hosts first. Depot note: AMS-Depot-3 bench power test needs 48h booking.

depot_marta: Confirm depot can receive direct air but must have AWB + full serial CSV 24h prior. We require crate foam spec and a printed shock log inside each crate for warranty intake. QR-coded RMA labels accelerate processing.

finance_olga: Budget check: +10.2k surcharge for air 6 H200. We can approve as emergency spend if ops open OPS-6001 and tag PO. Prefer vendor 20/80 insurance on air if vendor preprints RMA labels and includes photo-evidence clause; otherwise 35/65 unified is acceptable. Need an invoice line for duty prepay if vendor advances.

ops_zoe: vendor_nathan  can you confirm AWB will include original serials (no temp IDs), attach a serial->crate mapping CSV, and include preprinted QR RMA labels and a printed photo checklist? Also request a 72-hour RMA booking SLA for air DOAs and 10-day SLA for sea DOAs.

vendor_nathan: Confirmed: AWB will have original serials, we will attach a serial CSV and crate mapping. QR RMA labels and photo checklist will be inside each crate. Shock log included. 72-hour SLA for air DOAs OK, 10 days for sea. AWB preview: https://shipments.vendorco.com/manifest/VN-1759  AWB VN1759-01 for air leg.

sre_liam: Please add this to the replacement runbook: tag hosts eu-west-1-n12..n14 as priority, schedule cordon/drain in 90-min windows, do a single-node canary replace first to validate power/cooling at AMS-Depot-3. If only partial arrives stage to avoid the depot backlog.

ops_zoe: Opening surge-budget ticket OPS-6001: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-6001. Scheduling maintenance windows: canary tonight 22:30-23:00 UTC, bulk replacements tomorrow 02:00-05:00 UTC. Also request depot_marta to reserve bench for power test after AWB confirmation.

depot_marta: ack  reserving bench if AWB + serial CSV posted 24h before ETA. We'll run a 30-min power/thermal bench test during canary and upload photos to the manifest.

vendor_nathan: ack  will push final AWB + customs clearance receipt and the serial CSV into this thread when PO amend done. We will prepay duties for the air leg if you accept air surcharge. Invoice will include a duty prepay line.

finance_olga: ack  starting PO amendment. I'll accept vendor 20/80 insurance on air only if the RMA/photo clause and shock-log requirement are in the PO. Otherwise change to 35/65.

tracking-bot: manifest uploaded: https://shipments.vendorco.com/manifest/VN-1759  Carrier ETA (air) in 48h, sea ETA +11d.

ops_zoe: Final checklist before we close: 1) PO amendment (finance_olga) 2) AWB + serial CSV + shock log (vendor_nathan) 3) Bench reservation confirmation (depot_marta) 4) OPS ticket OPS-6001 created and maintenance windows scheduled (ops_zoe). Reply with "ack" when each task is done. :thumbsup:

finance_olga: ack  PO amend initiated.

depot_marta: ack  bench reserved for canary and bulk slot.

vendor_nathan: ack  AWB VN1759-01 and serial CSV will be posted to thread when PO amend complete.

sre_liam: ack  will post replacement runbook updates to #eng-sre and link here.

ops_zoe: thanks all. Closing this thread after AWB + PO live.
